We need to correctly format the tool call.

Let's do:

<thought>We will search for templates that break nitro and form primary amines, using the amine product SMILES as target.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1", "functional_groups_broken": ["nitro"], "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"], "limit": 5}</action_input>
